website.notes: Official About page (fetched 2026-10-08). Self-description: 'India's 1st and most trusted pet care brand'. Origin: started in a small room; 'big retail break in 2008 as a tiny kiosk at the Select City Mall in New Delhi'. Grew 'one store at a time'. Stats block on page: 13000+ Pet Products, 250+ Brands, 400+ India First Products, 20+ Indian Cities, 100+ Stores, 80+ Expert Pet Spas. Serves 2,00,000 families. 2017: Heads Up For Tails and Tail Lovers Company joined forces, operating under the HUFT name. Founder: Rashi Narang. Mission: 'To create and curate, innovative products and services that bring joy to pets and their families, one home at a time.' Values (from /pages/careers): Innovation, Joy, Impact, Commitment, Courage. Also runs HUFT Foundation (sterilisation, feeding, adoption drives, reflective collars for street dogs) and pet adoption site petadoption.headsupfortails.com. Registered entity: Earth Paws Private Limited, First Floor, Plot No. 34, Institutional Area, Sector-32, Gurugram, Haryana-122001 (confirms Gurugram base for the posting's Gurugram office). Careers page lists hiring flow: phone interview, culture interview ('attitude over aptitude'), technical assignment, final panel; 10-12 days overall; contact hireme@headsupfortails.com. Site is a Shopify storefront (D2C e-commerce) with store locator at stores.headsupfortails.com, franchise program page (/pages/become-a-heads-up-for-tails-franchise), HUFT mobile app, coupon/offer engine, loyalty features (Birthday Club), and pet spa booking.
